verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance's own docs show one platform covering the story's core. Entity Manager automatically displays registrations, statuses and key data per entity, including an interactive map. Users can see filing status and approved documents, and service-of-process documents arrive electronically. Reminders are 'customizable by user', which implies multi-user accounts, but team access is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of team or multi-user seats and permissions on a single account, a unified received-documents inbox across all entities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
